skill.name: verification-before-completion
skill.description: Requires fresh verification evidence before reporting tests, builds, fixes, requirements, or delegated work as complete.
skill.summary: Verify work with current command output before making completion claims.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Unverified completion claims create defects and erode trust. This skill requires fresh command output before reporting tests, builds, fixes, or requirements as complete.
actual_capabilities: Requires fresh verification evidence before any completion claim.
Maps test, lint, build, bug-fix, and requirement claims to appropriate evidence.
Checks complete output, exit status, and failure counts before reporting results.
Guides independent review of delegated agent work through diffs and verification.
Explains red-green checks for regression tests.
limitations: Does not select the exact verification command for every project.
Does not guarantee that existing tests cover every requirement.
Cannot verify results when command execution or output access is unavailable.
Focuses on completion evidence, not implementation strategy.

use_cases.title: Validate a completed change
use_cases.description: Run relevant tests and inspect full results before telling stakeholders that the change is complete.

use_cases.title: Review delegated implementation
use_cases.description: Compare an agent report with the version control diff, requirements, and fresh verification output.

use_cases.title: Confirm release readiness
use_cases.description: Require current build, test, and checklist evidence before approving a release or pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a test claim
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the relevant test command for [change]. Read the complete output and report the exit code, pass count, and failures before claiming success.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner verification of a completed code change

prompt_templates.title: Verify a build
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full build for [project]. Report the exit status, important warnings, and any failures before stating whether the build succeeds.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build validation before a completion statement

prompt_templates.title: Confirm a bug fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Reproduce [bug], apply the fix, rerun the reproduction, and execute related tests. Report evidence and remaining gaps without assuming completion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Regression verification for a reported defect

prompt_templates.title: Audit delegated work
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the agent report for [task], inspect the version control diff, run full verification, compare requirements, and report only evidence-supported conclusions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced independent validation of delegated implementation

output_examples.input: Can I report that the tests pass after changing the parser?
output_examples.output: Not yet. Run the relevant test suite, inspect the complete output, and report the result with pass counts and failures.

output_examples.input: The linter is clean. Is the build complete?
output_examples.output: A clean linter does not prove compilation. Run the full build and confirm a successful exit status before reporting completion.

output_examples.input: Another agent says the feature is finished.
output_examples.output: Inspect the version control diff, compare every requirement, and run fresh verification before accepting the completion claim.

best_practices: Use fresh evidence from the current work session.
Run the full command that directly proves the claim.
Report failures and remaining gaps with the same visibility as successful checks.
anti_patterns: Do not replace command output with confidence or assumptions.
Do not treat lint results as proof that a build succeeds.
Do not trust delegated completion reports without independent review.

faq.question: When should this skill be used?
faq.answer: Use it before reporting completion, creating a pull request, committing finished work, or moving to another task.

faq.question: Does a previous test run count?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires fresh evidence that reflects the current code and current claim.

faq.question: Is a passing linter enough?
faq.answer: Only for a lint claim. Build, test, and behavior claims require their own verification.

faq.question: How does it handle bug fixes?
faq.answer: Reproduce the original symptom, verify the fix, and run relevant regression tests before reporting success.

faq.question: Can it verify another agent's work?
faq.answer: Yes. Inspect the diff, compare requirements, and run independent verification instead of relying on the agent report.

faq.question: What happens when verification fails?
faq.answer: Report the actual failure evidence and remaining work. Do not describe the task as complete.
